technical_caveats.radar_frame_rate_vs_field_update_rate: R60ProbeStats.valid_frames (+34,878 over 7,199.8s, ~4.84 Hz average, 4..8 frames/s) counts all valid R60 UART frames across all control words (heartbeat, work state, presence 0x80/0x01, motion 0x80/0x02, body movement 0x80/0x03, distance 0x80/0x04, XY position 0x80/0x05, breath, heart rate, sleep). By contrast, R60ProbeStats.target_observations (+3,599 over 7,199.8s) counts only 0x80/0x05 XY coordinate frames and increments at 0.50 Hz (1 frame every 2,000 ms), while R60ABD1Component::publish_position_ further throttles state publishing to >=1,000 ms. Therefore, total UART frame rate (~5 Hz) must NEVER be equated to per-field update intervals for position.xy, presence, breath_rate, or heart_rate.
technical_caveats.heap_largest_free_block_vs_fragmentation: Equal largest_free_block (114,688 B) in G0-05 point-in-time snapshots and zero net free_heap drift (start 192,864 B, end 192,864 B, range 192,672..194,672 B) in G0-03 prove that the static-buffer G0 probe does not leak heap over 2 hours, but a single-point largest_free_block comparison does not prove absence of heap fragmentation under arbitrary dynamic allocations. WP-2 production firmware must retain static/bounded buffers and zero per-frame heap allocation.
technical_caveats.diag_page_lifecycle_vs_installer_5_branc: G0-04 verified real-hardware Web Serial open/handshake/capture/close/reopen in Chrome 155 on g0-diag.html, and unit tests verified esp-web-tools@10.4.0 port lifecycle rules, but the 5 full esp-web-tools UI dialog branches (install success -> console, install failure, user cancel, dialog close, physical unplug during install) have not yet been executed end-to-end on real hardware in the production console UI and remain mandatory B-04 / G3 / G4 verification items.

frozen_in_mwcp_v1: Binary envelope (MWCP magic, version 1.0, kind, flags=0, session_id, request_id, code, wire_seq, payload_len, CRC32C, COBS + 0x00 delimiter)
HELLO (0x0001) handshake with 32-hex nonce & boot_id, session_ttl_ms=15000, limits (max_payload=4096, rpc_inflight=1, event_budget_bps=1000..8000)
PING (0x0002), SESSION_CLOSE (0x0003), DEVICE_INFO (0x0010), STATUS_GET (0x0012), SUBSCRIBE (0x0030), UNSUBSCRIBE (0x0031)
TELEMETRY (0x8001) envelope with source_seq, sent_ms, origin, presence, targets_quality, targets_ms, targets
STATUS_GET optional diagnostic fields free_heap (bytes) and reset_reason (string|null)
g0_probe_only_extensions: TELEMETRY.ext.g0 = { free_heap, largest_free_block, stack_high_water_bytes, max_loop_us, radar_bytes, radar_targets } (permitted by schema.$defs.telemetry.properties.ext maxProperties=8 for G0 diagnostics; not required in production WP-2 telemetry)
